== Enshrined deities ==
There are three main sanctuary buildings, each enshrining the following deities.

== History ==
Until the Edo period, Takaoka Sekino Shrine consisted of three shrines - Kakumi Shrine (Shinmei Shrine), Sekino Shrine (Kumano Shrine), and Takaoka Shrine (Inari Shrine) - collectively called the Sekino Three Shrines.

'''Kakumi Shrine''' (かくみじんじゃ) is said to have been a shikinaisha small shrine in Kamiseki Village, Sekino-go (present Kamiseki, Takaoka). However, another candidate for Kakumi Shrine exists in Kojiro, {{ill|Himi, Toyama|ar|هيمي (توياما)|arz|هيمى|azb|هیمی، تویاما|ce|Хими|ceb|Himi (lungsod)|de|Himi|es|Himi (Toyama)|fa|هیمی، تویاما|fi|Himi|fr|Himi|gl|Himi|id|Himi, Toyama|it|Himi|ja|氷見市|ko|히미시|lb|Himi|ms|Himi, Toyama|mzn|هیمی، تویاما|nl|Himi (Toyama)|pl|Himi|pt|Himi (Toyama)|ro|Himi|ru|Хими|simple|Himi, Toyama|sv|Himi|tg|Ҳими|th|ฮิมิ|tl|Himi, Toyama|tr|Himi|tt|Хими|tum|Himi|uk|Хімі (Тояма)|ur|ہیمی، تویاما|uz|Himi (Toyama)|vi|Himi, Toyama|war|Himi, Toyama|zh|冰見市|zh_classical|冰見市|zh_min_nan|Himi-chhī|zh_yue|冰見|qid=Q646886}}, and there is a tradition that when this shrine attempted to raise a plaque reading "Kakumi," parishioners from Himi's Kakumi Shrine came and prevented its use.

In Meiji, Kakumi Shrine was merged into Sekino Shrine and ranked as a gosha. Takaoka Shrine became a prefectural shrine. == Former Seki Residence ==
A two-story wooden building (priest residence) east of the shrine, thought to have been built in the {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|ceb|Panahon sa Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} period.
